Virginia Cavaliers at Georgia Tech Yellow Jackets
Mississippi State Bulldogs at Georgia Bulldogs

highlights.headline: Highlight: Georgia outlasts 8-seed Mississippi State to move to SEC semifinals
highlights.description: Brennan Hudson hits the go-ahead hit in the fourth inning with a three-run homer to help lead the top-seeded Bulldogs over the other Bulldogs, 5-3.

Baylor Bears at Kansas Jayhawks
Florida Gators at Alabama Crimson Tide

highlights.headline: Highlight: 5-seed Gators crush 4-seed Crimson Tide in SEC quarterfinals
highlights.description: After three scoreless innings, Brendan Lawson and Ethan Surowiec jack solo homers in the fourth inning before the Gators post five runs in the fifth inning en route to a 13-3 blow out.
